# WestFrench Academy

> WestFrench Academy offers interactive French lessons in Rennes, France, designed for expats. Marion, a qualified French teacher (DAEFLE diploma), teaches small in-person groups in Rennes and private online lessons for those preparing to move to the region. A first trial lesson is available for €5.

## Pages

- [French (default)](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/fr): Homepage in French — courses, pricing, testimonials, and contact form.
- [English](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/en): Homepage in English for English-speaking expats.
- [Spanish](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/es): Homepage in Spanish for Spanish-speaking expats.

## Key sections

- [Group courses in Rennes](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/fr#courses): Small-group French classes (3-8 people) by level, held at La Maison des Associations in Rennes.
- [Online courses](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/fr#online-courses): Private online French lessons for people preparing to move to northwest France.
- [About Marion](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/fr#about): Background and teaching philosophy of the school's teacher.
- [Contact / booking](https://www.westfrench-academy.com/fr#contact): Contact form to book a trial lesson.
